message.content: {"verdict":"runtime","cause":"PROMPT_CACHE_CHANGES_OUTPUT","fix":{"action":"change_runtime_flag","target":"--no-cache-prompt (or send \"cache_prompt\": false in the request)","value":"disabled"},"rationale":"Both calls use the same prompt (33 tokens), temperature 0 and seed 42, but the first call evaluated 32 tokens fresh (cache_n 1) and the second reused 28 cached tokens and evaluated only 5 (cache_n 28). The replies differ, and per the user every later call matches the second one, so the split follows cache state and not the seed or the Q4_0 quant. Prompt evaluation in different batch shapes (32 tokens vs 5) gives slightly different KV values on the GPU, and at greedy decoding this flips an early token and diverges the whole story. With prompt caching off, every call takes the fresh path and the outputs should be identical."}
